ann.t: Copy of Newspaper Publication — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication pertaining to public announcement for buyback
General Updates — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates regarding Public announcement and board resolution for buyback
Public Announcement - Buyback of Shares — MEDIASSIST: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange about public Announcement and board resolution for Buyback of Shares
Record Date — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Buyback is 20-Nov-2026.

Buyback — MEDIASSIST: Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company in their meeting held on October 30, 2026 have approved the Buyback of fully-paid up equity shares of the Company through the  tender offer  route
Outcome of Board Meeting — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Press Release — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 09, 2026, titled "Medi Assist Q1 FY27: Revenue Up 24.1%   Paramount Integration is at its logical closure; AI Platform Contracts Signed; International Platform Established".

Monitoring Agency Report — Statement of deviation or variation in utilisation of funds raised through Preferential Issue for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 and Monitoring Agency Report issued by CARE Ratings Limited
Outcome of Board Meeting — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Appointment — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Ms PricewaterhouseCoopers Services LLP  as Internal Auditors  of the company.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Resignation — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Himanshu Rastogi as Senior Management Personnel  of the company w.e.f. February 06, 2026.

Cessation — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Ms Himani Atul Kapadia as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. March 14, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
Updates — Medi Assist Healthcare Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation on conversion of Statutory Auditor''s Firm into an LLP'.
